subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To be off the hook

options.text: To be close to the target

solution:
The correct answer is **To escape a difficult situation.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• ** **If someone is off the hook, he/she has **escaped a difficult situation**.
 
• **Example:** *Now he is off the hook as he was able to submit the assignment just a second before the deadline, otherwise he has to face punishment.*
